vopros: I'm looking for a preschool near UCLA where my 3-year-old can learn Spanish or French through immersion. Which schools should I contact?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Here are the strongest options to contact near UCLA for a 3-year-old seeking **Spanish or French immersion**:

| School | Language / fit | Location relative to UCLA | Contact / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **WorldSpeak Preschool — Westwood** | Multilingual preschool with **Spanish and French immersion**; serves roughly ages **2–3 years 11 months**. | **Very close** — 1639 Westwood Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90024 | Probably your best first call for either language and the most convenient UCLA-area option. Ask which French/Spanish classroom has availability and whether the program is full-day or part-day. [WorldSpeak listing](https://winnie.com/place/worldspeak-preschool-los-angeles) |
| **Saint Sebastian School Preschool** | **Full Spanish-immersion** classrooms for 2- and 3-year-olds; teachers use Spanish throughout the day. | West Los Angeles, short drive from UCLA | Minimum age is 2.5 by Sept. 1. Call **310-473-3337** or email **admissions@saintsebastianschool.com** to arrange a tour. [Program details](https://saintsebastianschool.com/catholic-preshool-west-los-angeles/) |
| **1-2-3 Soleil / Petits Polyglottes** | **Full French immersion** for children **1–3**. | Mar Vista, south of UCLA | A good French-specific option if your child is still eligible for its age band; confirm whether it accepts children who have already turned 3 and what the next-class placement is. [Website](https://www.123soleil-childcare.com/) |
| **Alouette Childcare & Preschool** | Appears to offer programs for **ages 3–5** as well as younger children; worth asking specifically about French-language exposure/immersion. | Near Kelton & Palms, in the Westside area | Especially convenient if you are south of UCLA. [Website](https://www.alouette-childcare.com/) |
| **Intiwasi School** | **Spanish-English immersion**, inquiry-based/IB-aligned program. | Pico–Robertson — 9017 W. Pico Blvd., LA 90035 | Call **(424) 527-0098** and ask about preschool entry at age 3, daily Spanish percentage, and openings. [Website](https://www.intiwasischool.com/) |
| **Yachaywasi / Intiwasi sister school** | **100% Spanish-language** toddler/preschool environment, ages **12 months–5 years**. | Miracle Mile/Mid-Wilshire; farther but feasible from UCLA | Best for families wanting an explicitly Spanish-only setting rather than a dual-language model. [Website](https://www.yachaywasi.us/) |
| **Footsteps Child Care — Mid-City** | Spanish-immersion toddler/preschool program; preschool serves **ages 3–6**. | Mid-City, east/southeast of UCLA | Has full- and part-time options; a useful Spanish option if the closer schools are full. [Website](https://footsteps.la/) |

### Suggested order to contact
1. **WorldSpeak Westwood** — closest and offers both target languages.  
2. **Saint Sebastian** for Spanish or **1-2-3 Soleil** for French.  
3. **Intiwasi/Yachaywasi** if you want a stronger Spanish-first environment.

When you call, ask: **(1)** whether the class is truly full immersion versus bilingual exposure, **(2)** age cutoff and toilet-training policy, **(3)** current/waitlist availability, **(4)** schedule and tuition, and **(5)** how much time teachers speak the target language each day.
